about: mon_sprite_swap also reaches the monster sprites a cell picks while drawing (DRINK goblin, second G.BANG goblin, GIANT monster heads) and the ogre carrying the captive. Test mod harness_swap renames those vanilla sprites to spr_title_top, which no cell draws otherwise. Fixture modded has occupied DRINK (11), G.BANG 1 (18) and GIANT (37) cells; each draw_probe runs the cell's real draw with the unit given the swapping class until the stand-in shows up.
